Contract Generator.contract:
Contract ProcessSaleService::enterItem(barcode: Integer,quantity: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		item: Item = Item.allInstance()->any(i|i.Barcode = barcode)
	precondition:
		currentSale.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		currentSale.IsComplete = false and
		item.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		item.StockNumber>0
	postcondition:
		let newSaleLine: SalesLineItem in
		newSaleLine.oclIsNew() and
		SalesLineItem.allInstance()->includes(newSaleLine) and
		currentSale.ContainedSalesLine->includes(newSaleLine) and
		newSaleLine.BelongedSale = currentSale and
		newSaleLine.Quantity = quantity and
		item.StockNumber = item.StockNumber-quantity and
		newSaleLine.Subamount = item.Price*quantity and
		result = true
}
